pages.text: When the atmosphere freezes in late Phase 6, your $(l:orsa_equipment/eva_suit)EVA suit$(/l) needs a canister.$(br2)Carry one in your inventory while wearing the full suit. It draws automatically: one tick of O2 per tick of breathing.
$(italic)Hyperventilating does not conserve oxygen. We checked.$()

pages.title: Tanks
pages.text: $(li)Multiple tanks drain one at a time$(li)The O2 HUD shows combined air across all tanks$(li)Refill in a $(l:advanced/geothermal_core)Geothermal Core$(/l) O2 slot at +10 O2 per tick; bigger tanks take longer
$(bold)Mk.I:$() 120s, cyan bar$(br)$(bold)Mk.II:$() 240s, blue bar$(br)$(bold)Mk.III:$() 360s, purple bar

pages.title: O2 Canister Mk.I
pages.text: Iron, glass and a Thermal Core to regulate pressure. Two minutes: ORSA assumed you would have airlocks. Kevin spent the airlock budget on an espresso machine.

pages.title: O2 Canister Mk.II
pages.text: Diamonds around a Mk.I canister. Enough air to leave shelter, finish a real task and get back. The most expensive air you will ever breathe, until the Mk.III.

pages.title: O2 Canister Mk.III
pages.text: $(l:advanced/frozen_atmosphere_shard)Atmosphere Shards$(/l), blue ice and a Mk.II. Cold to the touch. You are bottling the sky.
